title: fix(types)!: retire the published `layout` from RecordDetailsComponentProps
body:
Fixes #9040

Item 1 only — the whole remaining scope of the card. Direction 1 (the three keys
the spec declares and the renderer honours) landed under `Part of` in #9186 and
is not redone here.

## What this is

`@objectstack/spec` retired `record:details`'s `layout` in 17.0.0 (ADR-0087 D2,
objectstack#6946) and refuses the key **by name** — the tombstone is still a
declared member, so an author gets `invalid_type` at `layout` carrying the
removal prescription, not a bare `unrecognized_keys`. `RecordDetailsComponentProps`
went on offering a **third** spelling on top of that, `stacked | inline | compact`,
so no value it ever accepted could reach a published document: `tsc` said yes and
the platform rejected the document whole.

This removes the key. It is a **published-surface retirement**, so it ships with a
`minor` FROM/TO changeset and a migrated consumer set, ⛔ not a quiet deletion.

The key is removed, **not tombstoned**. The contract's refusal already arrives
named and prescriptive, so a `?: never` would buy nothing — the same reasoning
`.changeset/9280-record-highlights-entry-icon-retired.md` recorded for its arm.

## Premise, re-measured on this branch (installed pin 17.4.0)

Not inherited from the card. Controls in the same pass, so the instrument is not blind:

```
{ layout: 'stacked' } | { layout: 'inline' } | { layout: 'compact' }   RED  invalid_type at `layout`
{ layout: 'auto' }    | { layout: 'custom' }                          RED  invalid_type at `layout`
        …all five carrying "was removed in @objectstack/spec 17.0.0 (ADR-0087 D2)"
{ columns: '2' } · { fields: [...] } · { hideFields: [...] }           GREEN   <- CONTROL
{ inlineEdit: true } · { showHeader: true }                           GREEN   <- CONTROL
{ layoutt: 'compact' }                                                RED  unrecognized_keys   <- CONTROL
```

Live keys parse green (the schema is not refusing everything); a near-miss typo of
the same key gets the **other** code (the refusal is by name, not by ignorance).

## The consumer survey, and what it found that one pin did not

⭐ **The card's release comment named one consumer. There are three, and no single
instrument sees them all.**

**Instrument A — `tsc`.** One-shot ablation on the unmodified tree: delete only the
`layout?:` line, run `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`.
On-disk proof before reading anything: anchor count `1 -> 0`, blob
`c3c500d8fbcdce89a5a2e45469325b746eca1ebd -> 82124c21e38d8c27cdd58938270ca7f223129456`;
restore proved by state (`git diff HEAD` empty, blob back to `c3c500d`), never by an
exit code. `tsc` exit **2**, and it named exactly two files:

```
src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts(538,7): error TS2353: … 'layout' does not exist …
src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts(548,18): error TS2339: Property 'layout' does not exist …
src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts(141,3):  error TS2344: Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'.
src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts(141,43): error TS2339: …
src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts(146,37): error TS2339: …
src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts(156,3):  error TS2353: …
src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts(255,48): error TS2339: …
```

**Instrument B — vitest.** Same mutation, same trap, same on-disk proof; baseline over
the same four files first (`Test Files 4 passed (4) · Tests 52 passed (52)`). Mutated:
`Tests 1 failed | 51 passed` — and the one failure is a file `tsc` never mentioned:

```
FAIL packages/types/src/__tests__/record-highlights-layout-9187.test.ts
  > the DECLARATION carries the contract's two members and no third
  AssertionError: expected [ "'horizontal' ", " 'vertical'" ] to have a length of 3 but got 2
```

That file reads this declaration as **text** and used the retired key's three-value
union as its lit control. No type checker can see that read, and vitest cannot see the
two `tsc` found, because it strips types. ⚠️ A survey that stopped at the type checker
would have shipped a red test file.

**Instrument C — an authored-metadata census.** Every `record:details` occurrence in
every tracked file (115 files, 336 regions), scanning the region that follows each for
key-shaped spellings. Authored `layout`: **0**. Controls in the same pass over the same
regions: `columns` 21 · `sections` 44 · `fields` 49 · `inlineEdit` 5 · `showHeader` 4 ·
`hideFields` 1. Sensitivity check at a 100-line window: subject still **0** while every
control rises proportionally (55 · 91 · 149 · 11 · 7 · 3), so the zero is a reading, not
a window too small to contain anything. The seven raw `layout` hits in the wide pass are
all accounted for: spec `safeParse` probes, the internal `DetailView` node's own
`layout: 'vertical'`, `object-view` (a different interface), and this declaration's own
docblock.

⇒ **No authored document in this repository changes.** What changed is three pins.

## The three consumers, migrated — each with its reason at the site

| consumer | seen by | disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts` | `tsc` only | `layout: 'stacked'` and its read-back removed; reason stated in the literal's comment; a live-key read-back (`props.fields`) replaces the assertion the leg loses, so the migration does not quietly shrink it |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts` | `tsc` only | the "ledgered OPEN divergence" block becomes the retirement's own pin |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-highlights-layout-9187.test.ts` | vitest only | its lit control **moves** to `RecordChatterComponentProps.position`, as that file's own instruction required — moved, ⛔ never deleted |

⛔ Nothing here was edited to keep CI green. Every edit states why the key went and
where the fact now lives.

**The retirement pin** (`record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts`) now asserts the removal
on three instruments rather than ledgering it:

- a `keyof` absence — written that way because indexing a key that no longer exists is
  itself a compile error — **with a control**: `'columns' extends keyof …` read through
  the identical form must stay `true`, so an interface emptied by a bad revert cannot
  read as a successful retirement;
- a `@ts-expect-error` literal carrying a live `columns` beside the retired key, so the
  directive is specific to `layout` rather than to the whole interface disappearing;
- a new **source-text** leg, with the sibling's still-declared `layout` as its lit
  control and the block's live members as a second control against an empty slice.

The `PREMISE (spec-only)` leg that proves the contract refuses `layout` by name is kept
unchanged — it is the upstream fact this retirement rests on.

## Gates

All figures below are from the final commit, `a58320f`.

| gate | how it was run | result |
|---|---|---|
| dependency closure build | `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/types^...' build` | **EMPTY** — `@object-ui/types` has zero workspace deps, so the closure selects nothing (the run says so in as many words). Nothing to build; recorded rather than counted as a pass. |
| affected package suite | `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` (repo root, no `--`) | exit **0** — `Test Files 185 passed (185) · Tests 4252 passed (4252)` |
| affected package type-check | `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` | exit **0** — all three projects, including `tsconfig.test.json`, which is what compiles `__tests__` |
| affected package lint | `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types lint` | exit **0** — 0 errors, 284 warnings, every one a pre-existing `no-explicit-any`; the three changed files' own warnings are the `Equal` direction-proof lines their sibling pins carry too |
| consumer type-check | `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' build` then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` | exit **0** — the one importer of `RecordDetailsComponentProps`, against the **rebuilt** `d.ts` |
| `check:changeset-presence` | `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit **0** — 4 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset declared |
| `check:changeset-no-major` · `check:changeset-fixed` | node | exit **0** each |
| `check:changeset-claims` · `check:changeset-overwrite` | node | exit **0** (report-only) — see "Pending changesets" below |
| `check:spec-symbols` | `pnpm check:spec-symbols` | exit **0** |
| `check:installed-pin-claims` | `pnpm check:installed-pin-claims` | exit **0** |
| `check:new-line-citations` | `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | exit **0** — 0 new citations |
| `check:control-bytes` | `pnpm check:control-bytes` | exit **0**, plus a direct `grep -naP` over the changed files |
| `check:test-path-roots` | `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | exit **0** — the new source-text leg roots at `import.meta.url`, never `process.cwd()` |
| `check:unreferenced-sources` | `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` | exit **0** |
| `check:readme-exports` · `check:spec-floors` | after a full workspace build | exit **0** each. ⚠️ Both exit 1 on an unbuilt tree with their own "run pnpm build first"; these readings are post-build and therefore real |
| `check:published-dist` · `check:dist-completeness` | `pnpm check:*` | exit **0** each |
| `check:doc-types` · `check:prompt-keys` · `check:doc-snippets` · `check:doc-examples` | `pnpm check:*` | exit **0** each — 649 doc snippets compile against the **built** types, so no documented example authored the removed key |
| `check:node-esm-load` | `pnpm check:node-esm-load` | exit **1**, **NOT MEASURED and not a red on this diff.** Its provenance leg refused 2 of 37 entries (`@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/react-runtime`) because turbo's shared cache replayed a **sibling worktree's** build into this one (`/home/user/objectui-issue-9108`) — the gate names that cause and its own remedy (`--force-build`). Neither package is touched here; the load leg itself passed 32 of 32 gradable entries |

⛔ Every exit code above was captured before any pipe (`cmd > file 2>&1; EXIT=$?`), never
read through `| tail` or `| head`.

Repo-wide runs — `pnpm lint` (`turbo run lint` over every package), the four test shards,
`Build & E2E`, `Build Docs` — are CI's, and this is a declared narrowing to the affected
package plus its one importer, not a claim that the farm was run here.

## Acceptance notes

### Pending changesets — a declared, bounded step outside the dispatched fence

`pnpm check:changeset-claims` named **four** pending changeset bodies that name a file
this change touches, and its output addresses that read to this seat by name: "If a claim
did go false, CORRECT THE BODY", precedented, prose-only, frontmatter untouched. Two of
the four had gone false in that gate's WENT FALSE sense:

- `.changeset/9040-record-details-top-level-spec-parity.md` — said the retired `layout`
  "remains a published key `tsc` accepts" and "is now signposted at the declaration".
  Both describe a declaration this change removes.
- `.changeset/9187-record-highlights-layout-two-values.md` — said the removal "is
  objectui#9040's, still open", and that its pin borrows the sibling as a firing control.
  The removal lands here; that control moved.

Corrected in their own commit, prose only, both still `@object-ui/types: minor`.
`check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` reports the write and classifies it as its own case 2
("correcting a declaration on purpose ... legitimate"), which is the intended shape.

The other two read clean and are untouched: `8604`'s paragraph is about `columns` (that
file still writes `columns: '2'`), and `9280`'s is about the highlights `fields[]` arm.

⚠️ **Declared, not chosen silently.** The dispatch fenced this card at
`packages/types/**` plus the retirement changeset. `.changeset/**` is outside it, and the
two edits above are the repo's own gate asking the one seat that can answer cheaply. The
step is bounded — same defect class (a present-tense claim this very diff falsified),
mechanical and precedented in shape, no open claim on either file, same gate family, no
new verification surface — and it is named here rather than folded in quietly.

### Other

- `check:node-esm-load`'s provenance refusal is a shared-container artifact (turbo's
  cache is shared across worktrees of one checkout), not a reading about this diff. Noted,
  not filed: nothing is drifting and the gate already names its own remedy on the line
  that fails.
- ⭐ The ZONE 2 assumptions were all three measured. (1) The pin's quoted location
  `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts:533-548` had drifted: on today's `origin/main` the literal
  opens at 536, writes `layout` at 538 and reads it back at 548. (2) The survey is
  reported above and is **not** complete at that one pin — it found three. (3)
  `.changeset/retire-record-details-section-collapsed.md` is still present, unconsumed,
  and its shape is what the new changeset copies.
